verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches this story. Plaid documents webhooks that inform you about changes to Plaid Items, and a Dashboard MCP server with tools for debugging Items, which implies broken connections are surfaced programmatically. Plaid Link is documented as the client-side linking component, but nothing in the pack shows it offers a re-authentication or update flow for existing Items. Missing for 10: documented error/status codes for expired or revoked links, evidence of a Link update mode that repairs an existing Item without relinking, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the repair flow.
